title: rete/1: the network of the transformation products
description: The parent and the accepted products of tp/1 as nodes in columns by step, and an arc for every rule whose change of the ion formula takes one to another. Computed by crates/mzlab-feat/src/rete/; the view draws what it finds here. A network is not an identification and raises no level.

ppm.description: largest error of the observed difference of m/z against the mass of the change, ppm of the product

min_fragments.description: an arc from the parent with an MS2 compared is kept with at least this many fragments in common (equal or shifted)

parent.description: id of the row of the parent

nodes.description: by step, then m/z, RT and id; the parent first

arcs.description: by source id, then target id

row.description: index in the table and in the arrays of tp/1 (id = row + 1)

kinship.description: kinship of tp/1 (0 none, 1 doubtful, 2 possible, 3 probable, 4 certain); 0 for the parent

step.description: arcs away from the parent (0 = the parent); a group the parent does not reach starts at 1 from its earliest node

pos.description: place in the column, by m/z, then RT, then id

delta.description: change of the ion formula, gains first, true minus

delta_rt.description: RT of the target minus RT of the source, min

ms2.description: MS2 of the product against the parent; null when the source is not the parent or no MS2 was compared
